description: Listed Building Consent for the reconfiguration and upgrade of the concert hall backstage areas to include the amalgamation of smaller dressing rooms, changing spaces and support spaces to create larger, more flexible accommodation; the reconfiguration of the artist’s; rationalization of showers to provide a wheelchair accessible dressing room with an en-suite WC and shower; fire safety upgrades, updated layout of a rehearsal space to address occupancy issues, and provision of fire rated storage space and other associated works.
site_name: Barbican Arts And Conference Centre, Art Gallery
